name: carental
description: A full-stack car rental management system designed to streamline the process of booking and managing car rentals. This application leverages modern web technologies to provide a seamless experience for both administrators and customers.

scripts.install: npm run install:api && npm run install:client
scripts.build: npm run build:api && npm run build:client
scripts.dev: npm run dev:api & npm run dev:client
scripts.lint: npm run lint:api & npm run lint:client
